Veterinary Oncologist
Join a Progressive Talented ER and Specialty Team in the warm, sunny coast of South Carolina!
New River Veterinary Specialists is actively hiring to add a Board-Certified Oncologist, or Board-eligible Veterinary Oncologist to our team.
Our privately-owned facility is located 25 minutes from historic Savannah, GA and 12 minutes from the beaches of Hilton Head Island, SC. NRVS is a brand-new custom built 15,000-square foot state of the art facility with a full in-house lab, 16-slice helical CT, 1.5-telsa MRI, fluoroscopy, interventional radiology suite, multiple ultrasounds, in house blood bank and component therapy, arthroscopy, laparoscopy, minimally invasive surgery, full service sports medicine and rehabilitation department and a dedicated intensive care unit including long-term mechanical ventilation.
Our oncology department is equipped with a USP 800 approved hood and chemotherapy suite, dedicated examination and procedure area with the plan to add radiation therapy department in the future.
The NRVS team currently includes 1 Internist, 2.5 Criticalists, 1 Surgeon (also Certified in Rehabilitation and Sports Medicine), 11 Emergency doctors, a VTS-ECC and an amazing team of technicians & assistants. Our Internal Medicine service runs an active interventional radiology and interventional urology service completed with Holmium laser. We are also actively adding Cardiology, Ophthalmology, Neurology, and Dermatology to our service offerings.
We are offering a unique opportunity for the right individuals to shape their own specialty service and contribute to the culture of the hospital. We believe that there should be no barriers between emergency doctors and specialists. A collegial team approach to medicine is what we promote thereby providing our clients and patients with the highest level of collaborative care. We work closely with the veterinarians in the region to provide seamless care for their patients and clients. We are committed to delivering an exceptional client experience.
We are searching for a clinician who enjoys working closely with other specialists and emergency doctors and practices top tier medicine. We understand that practice can be stressful, and we value work-life balance. We will give you the tools you need to practice at the highest level.
We have a $200k base salary with 25% production and no negative accrual. Four, 10-hour shifts and our benefits package includes CE, organizational dues/licenses, health & dental insurance, supplemental insurance, 401K with 4% match, PTO, paid sick time and pet insurance allowance.
The Bluffton, SC region is family friendly with a walkable downtown, frequent festivals and outdoor events, access to the beautiful coastal waterways for boating and fishing, and close access to the historic Savannah, GA waterfront or Hilton Head Island, a top vacation destination.
